ruleDefinitions.name: System Information Discovery via Registry Queries
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects attempts to query system information directly from the Windows Registry.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*query.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-v.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/v.*"))) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Get\\-ItemPropertyValue.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*gpv.*")))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SYSTEM\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Control\\\\TimeZoneInformation.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SYSTEM\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Services\\\\Tcpip\\\\Parameters\\\\Interfaces.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Uninstall.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SYSTEM\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Services.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Schedule\\\\TaskCache\\\\Tasks.*"))
